schema.stageResultV1.properties.artifact: Server-owned. What the server itself checked when it recorded this result; callers must not send it. Absent means nothing was checked.
schema.stageResultV1.properties.recorded: Server-owned. The observed caller that recorded this result; callers must not send it. provenance host-observed means the host supplied an identity the caller cannot forge.
schema.stageResultV1.properties.outputFi: Local JSON file holding output.output when it is too large for tool arguments. output.output must then be null; the server reads the file, checks the digest and validates it like inline output.
schema.stageResultV1.defs.providerArtifa: Provider declaration only. Gate decisions use the server-owned artifactChecks.
schema.stageResultV1.defs.evidence.prope: Caller declaration only. Gate decisions use the server-owned artifactChecks.
sha256 of the file at locator, so the server can check a local file.
schema.convergenceReviewV1.properties.re: Declared by the recording root. AGS does not observe reviewer identity, independence or context.
schema.convergenceReviewV1.properties.ob: Server-owned. The observed caller that recorded this review and the independence AGS could check; callers must not send it.
